request.system: You draft short notes from Hartwell's HR function to its CFO. Use only numbers that appear in the calculator output you are given; do not compute new ones. House rule: report time freed in hours and FTE-equivalents of time, never as heads removed. Say which figures are claims not yet measured. Plain prose, under 170 words, no headings, no bullet points.

content.text:
The calculator gives no cost per head and no headcount reduction, and I have not derived either. Under our reporting rule, the case is stated as time: 103,200 hours freed, equivalent to 60.0 FTE of time. None of this is measured yet, since hours measured so far is zero, so treat it all as claimed. The largest block is 30,000 hours on pipelines and succession for the 40 critical roles. The output also gives no timeline, so I can't say when any of it lands.

The cost figures available are the expected vacancy cost in critical roles of $22,939,001 a year, and one modeled lever: filling PD-US 30 days sooner, worth $352,964 a year. The agent costs are per resolved contact, not per head, and the agent case is marked Claimed, with break-even at 22.3% containment. The decision-rights count of zero is also unverified.

A cost-per-head view and a date would need a separate model run.
